I can use the find command to look for files or symlinks named 'npm' in those directories, along with entries like npm-cli.js. My goal is to redirect this output so everything gathers cleanly into npm_candidates.txt.

**Preparing npm detection script**

I need to craft a script that checks for the presence of 'npm' and determines whether it’s installed. arguments:
{"script":"mkdir -p temp_npm_check
# capture PATH
echo "$PATH" > temp_npm_check/path_snapshot.txt
# enumerate common dirs
dirs=(/usr/bin /usr/local/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin /opt /snap/bin /usr/local/sbin "$HOME/.local/bin" /opt/homebrew/bin)
:> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt
for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    printf "== %s ==\n" "$d" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt
    ls -la "$d" >> temp_npm_check/dirs_listing.txt 2>/dev/null
  fi
done
# extract npm candidates (exact name 'npm')
:> temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
for d in "${dirs[@]}"; do
  if [ -d "$d" ]; then
    find "$d" -maxdepth 1 \( -type f -name 'npm' -o -type l -name 'npm' \) -print -exec ls -la {} \; 2>/dev/null >> temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
  fi
done
# also note any npm in PATH
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "command-v: $(command -v npm)" >> temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt
fi
# probe each candidate
:> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log
installed=no
# get candidate paths from npm_candidates.txt (lines that start with / or command-v)
grep -E '^/' temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt | awk '{print $9}' | while read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  echo "== probe: $p ==" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then
    "$p" --version >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>&1 || "$p" -v >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>&1 || true
  fi
  file "$p" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>/dev/null || true
  head -c 4096 "$p" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then
    out=$("$p" --version 2>/dev/null || true)
    if echo "$out" | grep -E '[0-9]+\.' >/dev/null 2>&1; then installed=yes; fi
  fi
done
# probe command-v path if present
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  p=$(command -v npm)
  echo "== probe: $p (from PATH) ==" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then
    "$p" --version >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>&1 || true
    file "$p" >> temp_npm_check/npm_probe.log 2>/dev/null || true
    if "$p" --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then installed=yes; fi
  fi
fi
# verification summary
:> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
for f in path_snapshot.txt dirs_listing.txt npm_candidates.txt npm_probe.log; do
  if [ -r "temp_npm_check/$f" ]; then echo "$f: OK" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt; else echo "$f: MISSING_OR_NOT_READABLE" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt; fi
done
candcount=$(grep -E '^/' temp_npm_check/npm_candidates.txt | wc -l || true)
echo "candidate_count: $candcount" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
echo "installed: $installed" >> temp_npm_check/verification_summary.txt
# write decision
echo "$installed" > temp_npm_check/install_decision.txt
# output decision
cat temp_npm_check/install_decision.txt
"}
